title: trainerframe
summary: The trainer session/window covers request/decode/buy/results, range expiry, authored ClassTrainer shell, live portrait/title, exact GameFont greeting/detail typography, purse and detail MoneyFrame coin cells, 11-row faux scroll, flowing service-name/rank rows with authored state colors, detail pane, Train/Exit, and transition sounds. Its current tree is complete: learn wrappers hop through EffectTriggerSpell to the taught spell's SkillLine, tradeskill trainers partition Development Skills/Recipes, mount-known rows use My Talents, headers and the All control use their authored fold/tab art, and the persistent Available/Unavailable/Already Known filter uses the exact UIDropDownMenu capsule and defaults to 1/1/0. Service rows carry no synthetic tooltip; the selected detail icon alone owns the shared spell tooltip at authored ANCHOR_RIGHT. Production geometry is owned by TrainerFrameUiLaw and DropdownCapsuleUiLaw; focused and full interface-wire suites pass.

openItems.text: Flat list: no collapsible skill-line tree headers and no Collapse All control (Benilla/backport groups services under fold-able skill-line headers)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: TrainerFrameUiLaw builds an interleaved header/service tree from the exact trainer-type group law. Individual headers and the All control fold/unfold groups while the 11-row faux-scroll projects the visible tree.

openItems.text: No filter dropdown (Available / Unavailable / Already Known visibility toggles)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The law-owned Filter dropdown toggles Available, Unavailable, and Already Known independently, retains the menu while toggling, resets scroll, and ships with the reference 1/1/0 defaults.

openItems.text: Title is the hardcoded string 'Trainer' - the NPC's name is never resolved into it
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: title resolves the bound creature name through the existing ask-once cache and retains the exact Trainer fallback.

openItems.text: No NPC portrait on the window ring
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the bound trainer now renders through the shared live unit portrait path at the authored 7,6 / 60x60 region behind the shell ring.

openItems.text: No player money purse display, and cost renders as plain text rather than the coin-icon money rig with red unaffordable tint
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: player purse and detail cost render NumberFontNormal values plus UI-MoneyIcons cells; unaffordable selected costs use the reference red tint.

openItems.text: TrainerFrame still rendered its greeting and detail copy through raw ImGui font sizes, used a generic 10px list label instead of flowing GameFontNormal/GameFontNormalSmall service text, represented header folds as text glyphs, and showed zero-level/zero-cost labels that current Benilla hides.
openItems.resolution: TrainerFrameUiLaw now owns the exact font identities, fixed text boxes, wrap/line placement, row flow and state colors, and header-icon seats. GameLoop.Trainer consumes those rules and hides empty requirement/cost surfaces while retaining the existing trainer protocol. Focused and full desktop clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: MSUI attached a synthetic requirements tooltip to every trainer service row, while current Benilla gives rows no tooltip and seats SetTrainerService only on the selected detail icon at ANCHOR_RIGHT.
openItems.resolution: The row-only ImGui tooltip was removed. TrainerFrameUiLaw now owns the detail icon tooltip bounds, and the selected icon offers the shared spell tooltip with OwnerRight placement.

openItems.text: Trainer Collapse All was painted as a generic panel button with '+ All'/'− All' copy rather than the authored three-piece ClassTrainer tab, separate plus/minus texture, additive hover texture, and small All label.
openItems.resolution: TrainerFrameUiLaw now owns the exact tab pieces, hit seat, icon seat, label center, font, and texture identities. GameLoop.Trainer paints the tab art and uses the shared collapse-all renderer without changing the rule-owned frame position, group semantics, or scroll reset. Focused TrainerFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Trainer's state filter was drawn as a generic panel button rather than the authored UIDropDownMenuTemplate capsule with fixed right-aligned Filter text and a separate scroll-down arrow toggle.
openItems.resolution: DropdownCapsuleUiLaw owns the exact shared capsule art, text box, arrow textures, highlight and toggle sound; TrainerFrameUiLaw owns the reference TOPRIGHT(-26,-64), width-96 layout. The existing three-state keep-open filter menu remains intact. Focused TrainerFrame/UiFoundation and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Trainer's open filter used an invented 126x58 dark/gold box, textual checkmarks, GameFontNormalSmall, and 17px row pitch rather than UIDropDownMenu's fixed-width dialog list, check/highlight art, GameFontHighlightSmall, and 16px rows.
openItems.resolution: The Trainer keepShownOnClick list now consumes DropdownCapsuleUiLaw's exact dialog bounds, three 96x16 rows, selected check and locked highlight art, hover highlight, colored GameFontHighlightSmall labels, and UChatScrollButton cue. Independent 1/1/0 toggles, open-menu retention, and scroll reset remain unchanged. Focused TrainerFrame checks pass.
